title: 군인의 시간외근무수당 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:35948:20251230:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 35948, December 30, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That amendments made under Article 4 of these Addenda to a Presidential Decree promulgated before this Decree enters into force, but whose enforcement date has not yet arrived, shall enter into force on the respective enforcement date of that Presidential Decree.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (41) Omitted.

(42) Part of the Decree on Overtime Work Allowances, etc. for Military Personnel shall be amended as follows:

In Article 4 (3), "Minister of Economy and Finance" shall be replaced with "Minister of Planning and Budget".

(43) through (176) Omitted.
